policy_fields.expires_at: exact admitted expiry supplied by sealed parent

transport_contract.fetch: returns exact {rev: opaque nonempty string, flows: bounded full private node array}
transport_contract.deploy: deploy(revision,flows) sends NodeRED v2/nodes through sealed transport; returns {state:accepted,rev} or {state:conflict,effect_proven_absent:true}; all other outcomes uncertain
transport_contract.authentication: trusted parent owns login/revoke and credential transport; engine sees no authentication values

trusted_coordination_methods.locks: context manager actually holding all existing shared locks throughout preflight-intent-RPC-verification-receipt; not caller input
trusted_coordination_methods.validate: validates exact plan with syntax graph layout observability isolated_regression installed_node_types canonical_sources_reconciled booleans and matching plan_sha256
trusted_coordination_methods.admit: binds exact policy hash plan hash operation action risk hash deploy nodes before revision before/after hashes and opaque approval_id to sealed authorization; confirms preserved interface confirmation, resource/lock state, reviewed startup/sensitive effects and at least90s remaining
trusted_coordination_methods.guard: guard(plan,phase=before|after) must return matching plan SHA and phase, credentials_unchanged and context_preservation_proven. Both phases are required. Logical delete also requires logical_delete_restore_isolated_proven; retiring own created nodes requires new_node_retirement_recoverable. Receipt stores only proof SHA/verdicts. Failed post-proof keeps deployment uncertain, never replayed.
trusted_coordination_methods.project_value_optional: returns exact_reviewed_public_source, exact original value and its matching SHA only after trusted public-source correspondence; never a caller-supplied public flag

operations.read: fixed views runtime (up to 16 nodes), plan_diff, node_field (public-proof-only 8 KiB fragments), policy; expected content hash binds continued pagination
operations.prepare: prepare(operation_id,expected_revision,expected_sha256,edits); duplicate original request returns original prepared plan before fetch/CAS
operations.status: status(operation_id); stored metadata remains available after expiry/revocation
operations.verify: verify(operation_id); read-only configuration proof, never functional/device proof and never converts uncertain receipt to applied; repeats after guard and reports protection failure explicitly, without promoting uncertain receipt
operations.rollback: rollback(operation_id,rollback_operation_id) prepares own reverse plan only; separate validate/preflight/apply authorization required; own created operational/tab IDs are retained disabled, declared retired_created_nodes/deleted_logically with their original data; configuration-node retirement without a proven disable capability is refused
operations.revoke: revoke(operation_id) closes own future authentication/effects, preserves receipts and read-only reconciliation

edit_schemas.node: bounded JSON node with id/type; no credentials/unsafe resource nodes/external module libs

edit_schemas.unset_fields: array of existing top-level field names

edit_schemas.expected_node_sha256: SHA256; logical disable retains ID and every original field

explicit_limits: No interface for shell, generic root, free host path, arbitrary endpoint, credentials or settings.
Create/edit exec, shell, daemon, file, file in, watch, tail, http in, tcp in, udp in, websocket-listener types refused; existing untouched nodes preserved.
No external module import configuration admitted.
Function code is administration with potentially broad runtime effects; static inventory is deliberately not a sandbox or authorization proof.
Deletion is logical disable; retirement and own-create rollback require separate recovery proof before data can be pruned.
Whole afterimage and revision must match for own rollback; no merge over later third-party changes.
Unknown intent or receipt blocks every new effect operation and is never released by matching configuration content alone.
Production lock/admission/credential-context/source validation adapters are required and must be sealed before activation; this private candidate alone grants no authority.

delete of a configuration node lacking a flow parent z and type!=tab is refused as configuration_node_quarantine_unavailable; validators must also reject configuration types masquerading as operational nodes.
